2.problem: On a piece of paper, Alan has written a number \(N\) between 0 and 2010, inclusive. Yiwen attempts to guess it in the following manner: she can send Alan a positive number \(M\), which Alan will attempt to subtract from his own number, which we will call \(N\). If \(M\) is less than or equal to \(N\), then he will erase \(N\) and replace it with \(N - M\). Otherwise, Alan will tell Yiwen that \(M > N\). What is the minimum number of attempts that Yiwen must make in order to determine uniquely what number Alan started with?
